preconditions.description: The number of operations q must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(ai) <= 15 for ai in assignments)
preconditions.description: Each assignment name ai must have a length between 1 and 15 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**9 for xi in priorities)
preconditions.description: Each priority value xi must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= di < i for di in undo_days)
preconditions.description: Each undo day di must be between 0 and the current day index i.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(count) if ai in to_do_list else '-1'
postconditions.description: For each query operation, output the count of assignments with lower priority or -1 if ai is not in the to-do list.
After all operations, the to-do list must reflect the state after all set, remove, and undo operations.

invariants.description: The number of assignments in the to-do list must not exceed 100000.

invariants.expression: all(ai in to_do_list for ai in assignments)
invariants.description: All assignments in the to-do list must be valid and present.
